description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModuleManager, which manages HTML modules for the HTMLPurifier library. It handles registration and setup of modules, doctype configurations, and element definitions pertinent to HTML sanitization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModuleManager
classes.description: Manages the registration, setup, and retrieval of HTML modules, doctype configurations, and element definitions for HTMLPurifier's HTML sanitization process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HTMLModuleManager with default doctype registrations and core module setups.

methods.name: registerModule
methods.description: Registers a new module to the recognized modules list, supporting class autoloading and optional overloading.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module to the current doctype by first registering it, then including it in the active modules list.

methods.name: addPrefix
methods.description: Adds a class prefix for resolving module class names during registration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Processes configuration and initializes modules, doctype, and element lookup tables based on allowed and safe modules.

methods.name: processModule
methods.description: Ensures a module is registered and adds it to the active modules collection.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Retrieves merged definitions of all safe and allowed elements from the modules.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves a merged element definition for a specific element name, considering module contributions and trust level.
